description: The rigging's song: a narrow band of noise at the Aeolian tone of the sheet, f = St × V ÷ d (Strouhal number St, apparent wind V, rope diameter d), heard once the wind is up. A bigger boat's sheet is thicker: its diameter grows as the fourth root of the main's area (its load, shared by a purchase that grows with the sail), 10 mm on a sail of 7 m².
